TODO(feature): Is it okay for an assertion to refer to a property that does not
yet exist? A researcher might want to write an assertion first, and defer
defining the property until the conclusion is recorded.

On the other hand, how to present an undefined property to a template?

-- test.glx --
events:
    test-event:
        type: birth
assertions:
    test-assertion:
        subject:
            event: test-event
        property: monkey

-- want-errors --

-- want-catalog.yaml --
assertions:
    test-assertion:
        subject: events/test-event
        property: monkey
events:
    test-event:
        type:
            definition:
                label: Birth
            value: birth
        properties: {}
        participants: []
